entrypoint.rule: Answer from AGENTS.md + this index. Open at most one route, then at most one shard.

routes.when: you need something from .agents and do not know which file
you need to know how the plugin, engine, asset pipeline and generated levels fit together
you are about to write, review or commit code in Code/ or tools/
something in this project looks ambiguous, contradictory or unverified
you need to know what is happening in this project right now
generating, changing or publishing a level, character package or imported mesh with tools/cry_asset_pipeline.py
configuring, building, running or debugging the C++ plugin (libGamePlugin.so)
the game renders black, flickers, shows black terrain, or logs missing-texture / missing-config warnings
sizing, quoting or planning a change to this project
running, adding or judging tests for this project
working on or estimating the "Clean the engine log" epic
working on or estimating the "Asset pipeline smoke-tested, higher-fidelity levels" epic
you need to pick up work, report progress, or estimate what is left
working anywhere inside Code/ (the C++ game plugin)
working anywhere inside tools/ or tests/ (Python asset pipeline, procgen, tracker, shader server)
you need to know what an environment variable configures or who needs it
you hit a term used in this project and want its meaning and where it lives
you need to know what a change ripples into, or what a kind of change costs
you need to locate the file that does something specific inside Code/
you need to locate the file that does something specific inside tools/ or tests/
